0.1.16: Added Discord-style message search with Ctrl+F shortcut and 12 filter types
Added emoji picker button in the message input bar
Search supports from:, has:, before:, after:, pinned: and more filters
Search results show message previews with avatars and timestamps
0.1.15: Added customizable keyboard shortcuts (Settings → Desktop App → Keyboard Shortcuts)
Ctrl+L instantly locks the app when a PIN or password is configured
Ctrl+Shift+M toggles microphone mute from anywhere in the app
Ctrl+Shift+D toggles audio deafen from anywhere in the app
Keybinds can be changed, cleared, or reset to defaults in Desktop Settings
System and conflicting shortcuts are automatically blocked when recording
0.1.14: Fixed menu bar appearing when pressing ALT key
Images now open in a fullscreen lightbox inside the app instead of a new window
Lightbox supports zoom (scroll/+/-), rotate (R), download, and open in browser
Blocked all same-domain popup windows — everything stays in the main app
0.1.13: Fixed file downloads not saving when clicking Save in the dialog
Downloads now show a native Save As dialog with the correct filename
Taskbar flashes when a download completes in the background
0.1.12: Fixed chat flashing/wiggling when sending messages
Added back button and Escape key support to Premium page
Fixed Check for Updates button getting stuck on Checking
0.0.10: Update dialog now shows a list of changes (What's New)
Added Release Notes section in Desktop App settings
You can now see changes for every version at a glance

Fixed scrolling on the CSS documentation page
Mention system now works in DMs and group DMs
Added #channel mentions with autocomplete in servers
Fixed typing indicator causing message input to jitter

Added version number display on the download page
Custom CSS documentation page with ready-to-use examples
Added CSS Guide button in Appearance settings

System tray minimize and close-to-tray support
Auto-update system with themed progress dialog
